explanation: The Kakeya set conjecture: every Kakeya set in ℝⁿ (containing a unit segment in every direction) has Hausdorff dimension n. Compactness is omitted, as documented. Keleti–Máthé (arXiv:2203.15731) show that the Hausdorff-dimension versions for compact and arbitrary sets are equivalent, so this is faithful. It is open for n ≥ 4.
